Choose one mode. Each time is saved separately, from 0 to 10 seconds, initially 3 seconds for both. 0 means immediately after safety checks, not off.\nEach-photo mode waits equally on the last photo, then opens the next post. If the slide number is unreadable, the optional fallback uses the whole-post delay; otherwise it waits.\nComments, menus, ambiguous screens and mixed media wait. Unconfirmed photo movement causes a safety stop. Overall execution off stops both modes.
